notes: Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1), PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90. Constructor arguments resolve in order to the chain's PoolManager and the newly deployed SIMDTEST. SIMDTESTHook is deployed directly with CREATE2 at permission mask 8396 (0x20cc). The manager and launch token are immutable; IMD, treasury 0x3dd5f73dd1a4e62630fad3909673f130ad429985 and fee parameters are constants. There is no proxy, owner, admin, setter or upgrade path. Only PoolManager may invoke callbacks. beforeInitialize accepts the SIMDTEST/IMD pair with this hook, fee 12500 and tick spacing 60, and records openedAt once. feeNow is 4000 bps before and at initialization, then 300 + floor(3700 * (3600 - elapsedSeconds) / 3600) until 3600 seconds, and 300 bps thereafter. beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas charge only the IMD side of exact-input and exact-output buys and sells, in addition to the static 1.25% LP fee. No dynamic LP fee flag, update or override is used. Swap fee accrual mints IMD-denominated ERC-6909 claims to the hook without transferring tokens during callbacks. Anyone may call sweep after settlement to redeem all claims and send them, plus any directly held IMD, exclusively to the SIMD Hackathon treasury. A sweep during an active unlock or sweep returns zero. pending reports claims plus directly held IMD; collected reports cumulative hook fees accrued and is not reset by sweeping. SIMDTEST is a standard 18-decimal ERC-20 with no transfer tax; its no-argument constructor mints the full 1e27 units to its deployer. Supply distribution belongs to the separately versioned launch policy. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96 provenance only; the factory determines the opening price from launch economics. Deployment, initialization and seeding must be atomic to establish the intended opening price and fee clock.
